test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a cause of food and water contamination?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bites by stray animals**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bites by stray animals do not cause **food and water contamination**, 
 
• **Food and water contamination** infects them with toxins and harmful chemicals which cause severe diseases such as diarrhoea, dysentery, and food poisoning.
 
• Food contamination results in the** development of bacteria, parasites, and other micro-organisms** which **enter our body and disturb our metabolism and other functioning.**
 
• **Chemical contamination of food and water **can even lead to **acute poisoning or long-term diseases, such as cancer.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Chemical runoff from factories **ultimately drains out into our water bodies which are the major source of water for man,** the waste from factories contaminates our water bodies which affect human as well as animal life.
 
• Incorrect food storage leads to the **spoilage of food at a faster rate**.
 
• Infectious organisms in the atmosphere occur because of different types of pollution like **emission of toxic gases, usage of chemical fertilizers etc it directly or indirectly affects our natural resources like contamination of water bodies, fertility of the soil, these adverse effects results in contamination of food and water at different levels.**
